set.body:
Use the packaged service, real PostgreSQL, a local identity provider and two labs on one installation. Use the same sign-in and Home routes as the researcher.

Acceptance criteria

1. Deposit an archive and a BIDS example under a named custodian. Prepare R1 and R2 with distinct descriptive canaries and verify the original release remains retrievable.
2. Share only R1. A researcher starting at Home finds R1 by its description, sees the appropriate coverage and retrieves files whose sizes and digests match the independent fixture. R2 stays hidden.
3. Exercise an intentional link-only share and a discovery-only share. Verify permitted metadata and bytes for each. A fresh steward browser sees server-backed grants, scope and expiry.
4. Revoke one of two independent access paths, explain the remaining basis, then end the last path and verify subsequent search, browse and retrieval follow current authority.

Verification

Record package and fixture identities, actors, per-step outcomes and independently computed file hashes. Leave a failed step open.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: ARC06: Rehearse deposit, discovery and revocation in fresh browser sessions
